name: FA_BONUS_RATES_
description: FA_BONUS_RATES contains the bonus rates used by the depreciation program to calculate depreciation for your assets that use bonus depreciation. When you create a bonus rule, Oracle Fusion Assets inserts a row into this table for each bonus rate you define.  The master bonus rule row is in FA_BONUS_RULES  table.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule.

columns.name: START_YEAR
columns.description: Starting year of asset life to which this bonus rate applies.

columns.name: END_YEAR
columns.description: Ending year of asset life to which this bonus rate applies.

columns.name: BONUS_RATE
columns.description: Bonus rate applicable for the year.

columns.name: DEPRN_FACTOR
columns.description: A denominator that is used to derive the depreciation rate for Polish declining methods.

columns.name: ALTERNATE_DEPRN_FACTOR
columns.description: The depreciation factor for the declining modified method.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
